name: Universal AI Browser Prompts 🌐
description_md:
# What You Get

- Copy-paste Quick-Start Template with all fields pre-wired: PERSONA, AIM, RECIPIENTS, THEME, CONTEXT, TASK, VERIFICATION, OUTPUT, SOURCES.

- Three simplified, ready-to-edit templates by use case: Research, Multi-Tab Comparison, and Autonomous Actions (with tab tags like @tab1, success criteria, and stop-before-final safeguards).

- Progressive Prompting Sequence (Stage 1 → Stage 2 → Stage 3) to move from broad context to focused research to a specific, verified deliverable.

- Built-in QA: generate 3 verification questions, answer each independently, and flag conflicts - no extra prompting needed.

- Output Blueprint controls: lock format, length, must-include elements, and structure so results arrive exactly how you need them.

- Works across agentic browsers and AI copilots (Perplexity/Comet, Genspark, Fellou, DIA, etc) without tool-specific rewrites.

Companion browser-specific recipes (offline model setups, agent triggers, pro shortcuts) live exclusively in my Early AI-dopters Community → https://www.skool.com/earlyaidopters/about
